issue_request: FHIR-3862 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU1. It requested changing the repeating Specimen.source backbone to a simple 0..* element renamed Specimen.parent, eliminating the source.relationship/target structure, and applying the approved parent/source definition and comment covering derived, component, and pooled specimens.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied in git commit d4d6920cb6b1d7485408225e1b91f4deeb011af3 ('[#3862] change .source to simple element .parent'), which changed the then-authoritative Specimen spreadsheet from Specimen.source to Specimen.parent, disabled source.relationship and source.target rows, and added the #3862 note plus the approved definition/comment. Later source refactors carried the content into source/specimen/structuredefinition-Specimen.xml.
additional_context: Specimen is an active resource in source/fhir.ini. The current Specimen StructureDefinition has Specimen.parent with min 0, max *, type Reference(Specimen), the #3862 committee note, and the Jira-approved definition/comment. Current source searches found no active Specimen.source, Specimen.source.relationship, or Specimen.source.target entries; Confluence and Zulip searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source edit was needed. The current build-scope source already matches the issue request and historical application, so the combined branch received an empty no-change audit commit.
